newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans down in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans down in moderate trade.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were lower in moderate volume trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with crushers digging their heels in and trying to improve their margins, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans slipped $3 for Rosario to $282. FAS sunflower seed was influenced downwards by soybeans for most ports, losing $3 for Buenos Aires to $230. Volume was goodish. Soybean and sunflower seed values slipped despite good ongoing oil export sales, according to some traders. FAS maize slipped $1 in the southern ports of Queuquen and Bahia Blanca as exporters found themselves covered and eased off buying.
